expected_behavior: The near-to-far camera sweep increases directional-shadow detail toward the camera and crosses cascade density regions without visible popping, stale shadows, or staircase-shaped penumbrae.
The thin warm blocker retains a finite stable shadow without disappearing or leaking as its projected footprint approaches a shadow texel.
The fully clipped alpha-mask blocker casts no shadow while opaque alpha-mask coverage retains the same cutoff semantics as the visible surface.
Double-sided shadow casters preserve their material culling semantics in both conventional direct and device-generated indirect shadow paths.
Close-contact and grazing-angle shadows remain attached without objectionable acne or peter-panning under the Ultra quality preset.
The conventional direct and device-generated indirect shadow paths produce byte-identical captures at matching camera phases and report zero qualification mismatches, overflow, and fallback draws.
